# Research brief: Will Bitcoin hit $85,000 on Binance BTC/USDT in August 2026?

I only used sources dated on or before 2026-08-22. Some search results mentioned later prices, and I left them out.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-08-21: The highest August price reported so far is just under $80,000. CoinDesk said BTC "came within a few dollars of $80,000 overnight" and put the intraday high at about $79,500. [CoinDesk](https://www.coindesk.com/tech/2026/08/21/live-updates-bitcoin-ether-etfs-pull-in-usd800-million-as-inflows-surge-for-a-second-day)
- 2026-08-21: An X market update gives the daily high as $79,233.08. [X/@marketsday](https://x.com/marketsday/status/2090726091938009112)

## 2. Current status
- The question is **not settled**. As of Aug 21 to 22, no source I found shows $85,000 printed in August. The best reported high, about $79,500 to $80,000, is roughly 6 to 7% below the target. BTC was trading near $77,000 on Aug 21.
- 2026-08-21: CoinDesk headline: "Bitcoin slips back to $77,000 after challenging $80,000 overnight." [CoinDesk](https://www.coindesk.com/tech/2026/08/21/live-updates-bitcoin-ether-etfs-pull-in-usd800-million-as-inflows-surge-for-a-second-day)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-21: Yahoo Finance reported BTC opened near $73,013 and was about $77,300 by 9:08 a.m. ET. It linked the move to the Treasury buyback announcement and to Trump urging Congress to pass crypto legislation. Strategy (MSTR) rose 10%, and Coinbase and MARA each rose 6%. [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/personal-finance/investing/article/bitcoin-and-ethereum-prices-today-friday-august-21-2026-cryptos-continue-rally-sparked-by-treasury-repurchase-announcement-161633891.html)
- 2026-08-21: Fortune put BTC at about $76,712 at 8 a.m. ET. [Fortune](https://fortune.com/article/price-of-bitcoin-08-21-2026/)
- 2026-08-21: Spot bitcoin and ether ETFs took in about $800M, the second straight day of strong inflows (CoinDesk headline). Commentators said BTC was on track for a weekly gain near 20%, its best week in more than two years. [CoinDesk](https://www.coindesk.com/tech/2026/08/21/live-updates-bitcoin-ether-etfs-pull-in-usd800-million-as-inflows-surge-for-a-second-day), [X](https://x.com/marketsday/status/2090726091938009112)
- 2026-08-20: Fortune put BTC at about $71,971, up from about $64,300 the previous morning. [Fortune](https://fortune.com/article/price-of-bitcoin-08-20-2026/)
- 2026-08-19: Treasury said it would roughly double long-dated bond buybacks to at least $4B per operation from Sep 9 to Nov 4. Reports say BTC rose 8.2% in under 12 hours, from about $64,100 to $69,500, with short liquidations adding to the move. Some outlets date the announcement Aug 20. [crypto.news](https://crypto.news/bitcoin-80k-treasury-buybacks-short-squeeze-august-2026/), [WhichBlockchain](https://whichblockchain.com/news/how-a-treasury-buyback-tweak-helped-bitcoin-surge-25-toward-80000-in-days/)
- Earlier in August (Fortune daily snapshots): about $62,707 on Aug 3, $64,137 on Aug 5, $62,829 on Aug 14, and $64,339 on Aug 19. [Fortune Aug 3](https://fortune.com/article/price-of-bitcoin-08-03-2026/), [Aug 5](https://fortune.com/article/price-of-bitcoin-08-05-2026/), [Aug 14](https://fortune.com/article/price-of-bitcoin-08-14-2026/), [Aug 19](https://fortune.com/article/price-of-bitcoin-08-19-2026/)

## 4. Base rates
- July 2026 (aggregator figures): open about $58,562, high $66,910, low $57,748, close about $62,814. That is a high-to-low range of about 16% for the month. [StatMuse](https://www.statmuse.com/money/ask/bitcoin-price-from-2020-to-now), [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/uair01/bitcoin-price-august-2026-beat-the)
- 2026-08-19 to 08-21: BTC went from about $64k to about $79.5k in roughly 48 hours, a 24% move. Volatility is well above normal right now.
- To reach $85,000, BTC needs about +10% from $77k, or about +7% from the recent high, within about 10 days. BTC has often made 7 to 10% intraday excursions within 10 days, especially after momentum breakouts, but a 10% move in 10 days is not the typical case. I did not find a formal statistical base rate for this.
- Commentary said the 50-week moving average, around $81k, could act as resistance. That source may be dated after Aug 22, so treat it with caution. [crypto.news](https://crypto.news/bitcoin-80k-treasury-buybacks-short-squeeze-august-2026/)

## 5. Other forecasts
- Polymarket runs "What price will Bitcoin hit in August?" with the same Binance 1-minute rule. It had about $28.4M in volume. I could not get the $85k price as of Aug 21 or 22. [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/what-price-will-bitcoin-hit-in-august-2026)
- Polymarket also has daily and weekly ladders, such as Aug 21, Aug 23 and Aug 24 to 30. I could not get their odds from before the cutoff. [Polymarket Aug 21](https://polymarket.com/event/what-price-will-bitcoin-hit-on-august-21-2026)
- Manifold has an August 2026 BTC price market, but I could not get a usable probability for $85k. [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/uair01/bitcoin-price-august-2026-beat-the)
- I found no Kalshi or expert forecasts specific to $85k in August.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Aug 27 to 29: Jackson Hole Economic Policy Symposium. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh gives his first keynote on Fri Aug 28 at about 10:00 a.m. ET. A BofA survey found 69% of fund managers expect a neutral tone. [XTB](https://www.xtb.com/en/education/jackson-hole-2026-warsh-fed-speech), [ATFX](https://www.atfx.com/en/news/market-news/jackson-hole-symposium-2026-what-you-need-to-know)
- Late August, exact date not confirmed: the PCE inflation release.
- Ongoing: daily ETF flows, follow-through on the Treasury buyback (operations start Sep 9, after the window closes), crypto legislation headlines, and weekend liquidity. Short squeezes can produce brief wicks, and a single 1-minute high above $85k would be enough to resolve Yes.

Caveats: My direct page fetches were all blocked, so most figures come from search snippets. Fortune's daily articles contain some internal inconsistencies.

# Research report 2 of 2 (written independently)

I couldn't load the Binance chart or API through the proxy, and Fortune, CoinDesk, Yahoo and Crypto.com pages wouldn't open either. Everything below comes from search-result summaries of articles dated on or before 2026-08-22. Anything published later was left out.

## 1. Resolution source
- I couldn't read the Binance BTC/USDT 1m chart or kline data, so I can't confirm the exact August high on Binance.
- 2026-08-22: Crypto.com's weekend update was titled "Bitcoin Brushes $80K After Treasury Buyback Sparks $2.7B+ Short Squeeze." It said BTC had cleared $78,000, up about 16% from Tuesday's lows. [crypto.com](https://crypto.com/us/market-updates/weekender-btc-80000-aug-22-2026)
- 2026-08-22: CoinDesk's headline said Bitcoin "surged 25% from $64,000 to $78,500 after a Treasury tweak." [coindesk](https://www.coindesk.com/markets/2026/08/22/how-a-treasury-buyback-tweak-helped-bitcoin-surge-nearly-25-in-days)

## 2. Current status
- Early August lows were near $62,700, so most of the month was spent in the low-to-mid $60,000s. [fortune](https://fortune.com/article/price-of-bitcoin-08-03-2026/)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-22: CoinDesk says about $4B of bearish positions were liquidated on Thursday and Friday (Aug 20-21). Analysts called the buyback a catalyst rather than a fundamental shift, and stressed it is not quantitative easing. [coindesk](https://www.coindesk.com/markets/2026/08/22/how-a-treasury-buyback-tweak-helped-bitcoin-surge-nearly-25-in-days)
- 2026-08-22: Crypto.com says the $73,245 "golden pocket" resistance has been cleared. It warned that a daily close below $68,000 could pull BTC back into the summer range. [crypto.com](https://crypto.com/us/market-updates/weekender-btc-80000-aug-22-2026)
- 2026-08-21: Yahoo Finance reports BTC opened at $73,013 and was about $77,300 by 9:08 a.m. ET. [yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/personal-finance/investing/article/bitcoin-and-ethereum-prices-today-friday-august-21-2026-cryptos-continue-rally-sparked-by-treasury-repurchase-announcement-161633891.html)
- 2026-08-21: Fortune puts BTC at $76,712 around 8 a.m. ET, about $4,700 above the previous morning. [fortune](https://fortune.com/article/price-of-bitcoin-08-21-2026/)
- 2026-08-20: Fortune puts BTC at about $71,970 at 6:15 a.m. ET. [fortune](https://fortune.com/article/price-of-bitcoin-08-20-2026/)
- 2026-08-19: Treasury Secretary Bessent said long-bond buybacks would be at least doubled, to $4B per operation, aimed at 10- to 30-year maturities. The 30-year yield fell from about 5.34% toward 5.19%, and BTC went from about $64,000 to above $70,000, an 11-week high. [cointelegraph](https://cointelegraph.com/markets/bitcoin-price-hits-11-week-high-as-us-treasury-doubles-debt-buyback-size), [cryptobriefing](https://cryptobriefing.com/bitcoin-surges-treasury-buyback-change/)

## 4. Base rates
- The 2026 peak was reported at $94,820 and the all-time high at $126,198, so $85,000 is well below this year's highs. [briefs.co](https://www.briefs.co/news/bitcoin-surges-as-treasury-s-bond-buyback-plan-shakes-market/)
- BTC traded mostly between about $62,000 and $65,000 from Aug 1 to Aug 19, then rose about 25% in 3 to 4 days. [fortune](https://fortune.com/article/price-of-bitcoin-08-14-2026/)
- My own rough estimate, not sourced: at the 45-60% annualized volatility typical for BTC, the 1-sigma move over about 9.5 days is roughly 7-9%. The needed gain of about 6-9% to an intraday high is about one sigma. Volatility right after a short squeeze is usually higher than that.
- Resistance levels cited around this time were $80,000 and $82,000. Some analysts said a sustained break above $80,000 could open a path toward $82,000-$87,000. I couldn't confirm the exact date of that analyst comment.

## 5. Other forecasts
- 2026-08-21: Forbes reported Polymarket odds of 85% for $80,000 in August. [forbes](https://www.forbes.com/sites/boazsobrado/2026/08/21/polymarket-shock-has-bitcoin-bulls-suddenly-eyeing-80000/)
- About 2026-08-21: Share Talk reported Polymarket at 35% for $82,500 and 18% for $85,000 in August, after BTC had already moved up. [share-talk](https://www.share-talk.com/bitcoin-traders-back-80000-as-polymarket-odds-jump-to-59/)
- 2026-08-12: Polymarket priced $80,000 at 32% and $90,000 at 17% when BTC was near $63,500. [bitcoin.com](https://news.bitcoin.com/market-updates/bitcoins-120m-betting-war-draws-a-brutal-map-for-2026-prices/)
- An aggregator listed the $85,000 contract at 22%, with no date given. [polysays](https://polysays.com/event/what-price-will-bitcoin-hit-in-august-2026)
- The Polymarket event page itself is [here](https://polymarket.com/event/what-price-will-bitcoin-hit-in-august-2026). I couldn't find any Kalshi or Manifold figures for $85,000 dated on or before Aug 22.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- More Treasury buyback operations at the larger size, and how long-end yields react to them.
- 2026-08-27 to 08-29: The Kansas City Fed's Jackson Hole symposium. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh gives his first major speech on Friday, Aug 28, at 10 a.m. ET. Markets were pricing about a one-in-three chance of a rate hike at the Sept 16 FOMC. [washingtonexaminer](https://www.washingtonexaminer.com/?p=4703956), [investinglive](https://investinglive.com/central-banks/jackson-hole-hype-outruns-warsh-playbook-of-saying-as-little-as-possible/)
- The July PCE inflation report is probably due in late August, but I couldn't confirm the date.
- Weekend liquidity (Aug 22-23 and Aug 29-30): thin markets after a squeeze can bring sharp wicks either way.
